description: This file defines the ReviewProvider class, which manages the state and interactions related to reviews in a Flutter app. It includes methods to load reviews from an API and submit new reviews, and it notifies listeners upon state changes.

classes.name: ReviewProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that handles fetching, updating, and notifying about review data.

methods.name: loadReviews
methods.description: Fetches review data from the API, updates internal state, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: submitReview
methods.description: Submits a new review via the API and reloads reviews afterward.
